visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens at night in front of the iconic Universal Studios Japan rotating globe. A young man wearing glasses, a beige hoodie, and a glowing star-shaped light around his neck is crouching on the cobblestone pavement, picking up a black wallet. The lighting is dark with bright spotlights hitting the globe in the background. (2) A transition shows a group photo of four friends (three men and one woman) posing in front of the globe, then cuts back to the man in the beige hoodie laughing while holding a Minion popcorn bucket. (3) The group walks through the theme park towards the 'Lost and Found' building. The camera is handheld, capturing the movement as they approach a lighted doorway. Other park guests are visible as blurred figures in the background. (4) Inside the building, the man is seen holding the wallet and gesturing towards a service counter while standing in a line. A dog-face emoji overlay appears on his face intermittently for comedic effect. (5) The group exits the building and stands on the sidewalk. One man in a black jacket (with blonde hair) laughs and accidentally bumps into a metal chain railing, causing him to stumble. The female friend in a blue beanie laughs alongside him. (6) The video concludes with the blonde man talking directly to the camera, holding a plastic souvenir bag, while the others stand behind him in the dimly lit park exterior.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat, high-tempo synthesizer pop music begins immediately. A male voice speaks energetically with a bright, high-arousal tone. There is light background chatter characteristic of a theme park. (2) A transition sound effect (whoosh) triggers as the group's laughter erupts. The main male speaker's pitch rises as he makes a joke. (3) The music stays constant as the group moves indoors. Vocal levels remain high, with multiple voices overlapping in a cheerful, conversational manner. (4) A distinctive 'ding' sound effect plays to highlight a text overlay. (5) As they exit, a loud metallic impact sound is heard followed by a sharp burst of loud group laughter. The laughter features wide pitch variability and high intensity. (6) The music volume swells slightly for the outro as the male voice returns to a steady, friendly narrative speed before fading into a comical cartoon-style sound effect at the end.
